n-k-k8-02.title: Mazwi aya ndeaani?
n-k-k8-02.topic: nhau: kutaura sosi uye ndiani anotsigira chirevo
n-k-k8-02.goal: Siyanisa zvinozivisa nyaya yenhau sechirevo kana kufanotaura kwemumwe nezvinoverenga sedata, uye uone chipfupiso chinoshandura chirevo kuita chokwadi.
n-k-k8-02.material:
Verenga nyaya pfupi iyi (yakagadzirwa).

□□시, 막차 1시간 늦춘다

□□시는 다음 달부터 시내버스 막차 시간을 1시간 늦춘다고 밝혔다. 시 관계자는 "이용객이 늘어난 노선부터 차례로 넓혀 갈 계획"이라고 설명했다. 지난해 밤 10시 이후 버스 이용객은 전년보다 12% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 한 시민단체는 막차가 늦어지면 귀갓길 사고가 줄어들 것이라고 주장했다. 버스 노조는 운전기사가 부족해 계획대로 시행하기 어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장을 내놓았다.
n-k-k8-02.prereq.1: Unoziva zviito zvekuzivisa senge 밝혔다, 주장했다, 설명했다
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ZVIRANGO ZVESE zvinongopfuudzwa nenyaya semaonero kana kufanotaura kwemunhu wekunze, pasina kutaura kuti ndezvechokwadi.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pachirevo chimwe nechimwe bvunza: ndiani ari kutaura, uye zvatoitwa kana kuti zvakatarisirwa chete?
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa zviito zvinopedza mitsara: zvimwe zvinoti 'zvakazivisirwa' kana 'zvakaverengwa', zvimwe 'zvakakakavadzirwa' kana 'chinzvimbo'.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.a: Ndiko guta rinozivisa sarudzo yaro pamabhazi aro; chinyorwa chinoshuma zvakataurwa neguta.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinoshumwa sehuwandu hwakaverengwa, kwete sepfungwa kana kufungidzira kwemumwe.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.e: Ihurongwa hwaguta pacharo, hwakataurwa nemukuru waro; hausi kufungidzira kwemumwe wekunze.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: b ne c zvose zvinofungidzirwa zvinoitwa neboka ('주장했다', '어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장'). Chinyorwa chinoshuma kuti vakazvitaura; hachitauri kuti zvichaitika chaizvo. a ne e ndiyo sarudzo nehurongwa hwaguta pacharo, uye d huwandu hwakaverengwa.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.prompt: Mumwe wekirasi anopfupisa chinyorwa mumitsara mishanu. Mitsara miviri inochinja chirevo kana kufungidzira kwemumwe kuita chokwadi chakajeka. Sarudza imwe yacho.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rongedza mutauri wemutsara wega wega wechinyorwa, wobva watarisa kuti mutsara wega wega wechidimbu unomuchengeta.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga mitsara apo kufungidzira kwave mutsara unotaura zvakaitika kana zvakajeka.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: Mitsara 3 ne5 haina kururama. Muchinyorwa boka revagari rinoti ngozi dzichadzikira, uye mubatanidzwa unotarisira kuoma chete. Mitsara 3 ne5 inodonhedza vatauri ndokuzviratidza sezvokwadi. Mitsara 1, 2 ne4 inochengeta mutauri.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Mumwe mudzidzi anonyora: '막차를 늦추면 사고가 줄어든다.' MuchiRungu kana muchiKorea, tsanangura chii chisina kururama pamutsara uyu, uchishandisa mashoko echinyorwa pachacho.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga muchinyorwa kuti ndiani chaizvo akati ngozi dzichadzikira.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Taura rudzi rwechirevo ichocho (sarudzo, huwandu, kana chimwe chinhu) uye chii chakaitwa nemutsara wemumwe wekirasi kwachiri.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura kuti ndiani akaita chirevo here?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura kuti ikufungidzira kana chirevo, kwete chinhu chinosimbiswa nechinyorwa here?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.model.0: Chinyorwa chinoti boka revagari rakakakavara (주장했다) kuti ngozi dzichadzikira. Ndiko kufungidzira kwavo, kwete mhedzisiro yakasimbiswa, saka mutsara unochitaura sechokwadi.

n-k-k8-05.title: Awa rechipfumbamwe pamwe nemaawa maviri nehafu
n-k-k8-05.topic: nzira dzekutaura nguva: 정각, 반, 정오, 자정; kupesana mukati mehurongwa
n-k-k8-05.goal: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yehurongwa hwekusangana kunoramba kuri yoga isingagone kuva yechokwadi nguva imwe chete, uiruramise, wobva watonga kuti chizivisiro chega chinoratidza mutsara upi wakanganisa.
n-k-k8-05.material:
'Chikoro chinotumira hurongwa uhu hwekusangana kwekuramba kwemanheru kuvabereki. Hverenga sehurongwa hwose.

수련회 일정 안내 (6월 14일)
※ 정각 = exactly on the hour, 정오 = noon, 자정 = midnight.'
n-k-k8-05.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga nguva dzewachi sa 11시 30분 ne두 시간 반
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.prompt: Mitsara miviri yehurongwa haigoni kuva yechokwadi pamwe chete. Sarudza chero imwe yacho.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa mutsara wega wega unopa nguva yekutanga nehurefu nenguva yaunoti inopera.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cherekedza mitsara inoenderana nemutsara uri pamberi payo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 1 ne2 inopesana: kubuda pa9:00 nerwendo rwemaawa 2 nehafu zvinoreva kusvika pa11:30, kwete 11:00. Mitsara 3 kusvika 6 inoenderana (12:00 + awa 1; 1:00 + maawa 3 = 4:00; 6:00 + maawa 1.5 = 7:30).
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara UMWE wemitsara miviri inopesana muchiKorea (kana nyora nguva yakarurama muchiRungu) kuti mitsara miviri ienderane.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Wedzera hurefu hwerwendo kunguva yekubuda wobva wanyora mhedzisiro.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: Unogona kuchinja nguva yekusvika, hurefu hwerwendo kana nguva yekubuda, asi zvitatu zvose zvinofanira kuenderana.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Nguva yekubuda, hurefu hwerwendo nenguva yekusvika zvinowedzera zvino here?
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Inogadzirisa hurefu hwerwendo panzvimbo yenguva yekusvika.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Mumwe wekirasi anoti: 'Obviously the arrival time is the typo.' Izvi zvakachengeteka kusvika pamhedziso kubva pahurongwa hoga here?
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rondedzera nhamba nhatu dzinofanira kuenderana wobva wabvunza kuti ndeipi iyo chinyorwa chinoratidza kuti hairurami.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bvunza kuti ruzivo rwekuwedzera rupi rwaizokuita kuti uve nechokwadi.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.a: Ehe: nguva yekusvika inouya pakupedzisira cheni, saka ndiyo yakanyorwa zvisina kururama.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.a: Nhevedzano yemitsara hairatidzi kuti nhamba ipi isina kururama; nhamba yekare inogona kuva kukanganisa nyore.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.b: Ehe: vabereki vachatarisa nguva yekusvika, saka chikoro chinofanira kunge chakanganisa.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.b: Zvinotariswa nevabereki hazvioneshi kuti nhamba ipi isina kururama.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.c: Kwete: mitsara miviri yatoenderana, saka hapana chinofanira kugadziriswa.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.c: 9:00 pamwe nemaawa 2 maminetsi 30 ndi11:30, izvo zvisingaenderani ne11:00.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.d: Kwete: chero ipi yenhamba nhatu inogona kuva kukanganisa, saka chikoro chinofanira kusimbisa.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.explain: Chinyorwa chinoratidza chete kuti nhamba nhatu (kubuda, hurefu hwerwendo, kusvika) hadzienderani. Chero imwe inogona kuva isina kururama, saka chikoro chinofanira kutaura kuti ndeipi yakasimba. Kururamisa kwawakanyora kufungidzira kunonzwisisika, kwete humbowo.

n-k-k8-01.title: Ndiani anokodzera mukati memiganhu yeziviso?
n-k-k8-01.goal: Verenga mazwi enhamba muziviso yepamutemo yevanozvipira, ita zvinyorwa zvakati wandei zvinosangana nemiganhu yese, uye utsanangure nemazwi ako kuti nei munhu mumwe pamuganhu ari mukati kana kunze.
n-k-k8-01.material:
Dhorobha rinoisa ziviso iyi. 만 N세 zvinoreva 'N makore nenzira yemutemo yeKorea'. Tora nhamba dzese sedzakazara.

청소년 봉사단 '이웃' 참가자 모집 안내
1. 대상: 만 13세 이상, 만 18세 미만 청소년
2. 팀 구성: 한 팀은 3명 이상 5명 이하
3. 하루 활동 시간: 최소 1시간 이상, 4시간을 초과할 수 없음
4. 활동 일수: 5일 미만
5. 인증서: 총 활동 시간(하루 활동 시간 × 활동 일수)이 10시간 이상이어야 받을 수 있음
n-k-k8-01.thinking.0: Kuverenga mazwi emiganhu: muganhu unosanganisira nhamba pachayo here?
n-k-k8-01.prereq.0: Unoziva mapeya 이상/이하 (anosanganisira nhamba) ne 초과/미만 (haasanganisire)
n-k-k8-01.prereq.1: Unogona kuverenga ziviso yepamutemo ine nhamba
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.prompt: Chikamu 3 chinoti '4시간을 초과할 수 없음'. Mutori chikamu anogona kushanda maawa 4 chaiwo pazuva rimwe here?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.0: Taura chikamu ichi mazwi ako mukurira: chii chakarambidzwa, maawa 4 kana chimwe chinhu?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira munhu anoshanda maawa 4 chaiwo uye ubvunze kuti chikamu chakaputswa here.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.a: Kwete: 초과 inosanganisira nhamba pachayo, saka maawa 4 chaiwo akarambidzwa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.a: 초과 zvinoreva 'kupfuura' uye hazvisanganise nhamba. Enzanisa ne 이상, inosanganisira.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.b: Hongu: kurambidza kuri pahuwandu hwose hwemaawa, kwete maawa ezuva rimwe.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.b: Chikamu chinoti chinoreva 하루 (zuva rimwe); huwandu hwose hunogumirwa zvakasiyana muchikamu 5.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.c: Hongu, asi kuboka rine nhengo shanu chete.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.c: Hapana chiri muchikamu 3 chinoenderana nehukuru hweboka; boka chikamu chakasiyana.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.d: Hongu: maawa 4 ndiwo muganhu pachawo; anopfuura 4 chete ndiwo akarambidzwa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.explain: 초과 zvinoreva 'kupfuura' uye inosiya nhamba, saka maawa 4 anobvumirwa uye maawa 5 haabvumirwi. 이상/이하 anosanganisira nhamba; 초과/미만 haasanganisire.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.prompt: Zadza imwe kunyoresa kumwe kunogoneka kunobvumirwa neziviso uye kunowana chitupa. Ita kunyoresa 3 kwakasiyana nemazera 3 akasiyana. a = zera (만 나이), n = hukuru hweboka, h = maawa pazuva, d = huwandu hwemazuva.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.0: Shandura chikamu chimwe nechimwe chine nhamba kuita mutemo pfupi pamusoro penhamba imwe usati wasarudza mitengo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga nezera, wobva wasarudza maawa nemazuva pamwe chete, nokuti chikamu 5 chinoabatanidza.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.2: Edza mutengo chaipo pamuganhu mumwe nemumwe (nhamba diki nenhamba huru yakabvumirwa nechikamu chimwe nechimwe) uye uverenge mameseji anoonekwa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Chikamu 3: awa 1 rakanyanya kuderera uye maawa asingapfuuri 4 pazuva.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Chikamu 5: maawa pazuva x mazuva anofanira kuva 10 kana kupfuura.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.explain: Mipendero: zera 13 riri mukati uye 18 riri kunze; mabhoka e3 ne 5 ari mukati; maawa 4 pazuva ari mukati; mazuva 5 ari kunze; huwandu hwose hwemaawa 10 chaiwo hunokwana. Kunyoresa kwakawanda kunokodzera nokuti ziviso inopa miganhu, kwete hurongwa humwe chaihwo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Shamwari ine makore 만 18세 chaiwo nhasi uye inoda kujoina. Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri (chiKorea kana chiRungu), iudze kuti inogona kujoina here uye nei, uchishandisa mazwi eziviso.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga nekusarudza sarudzo ye 18 chaiyo, wobva wataura izwi rechikamu rinosarudza.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti 이상 ne 미만 zvinobata sei nhamba yakanyorwa padyo nazvo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura zvakajeka kuti 18 pachayo hairatidzwi here?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakashandisa izwi 미만 kana kutsanangura zvairisiya here?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Haagoni kujoina. Ziviso inoti pasi pe 18 (미만), uye 미만 haisanganise 18 pachayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.prompt: Mushandi anopindura mibvunzo nezveziviso imwe chete. Mitsara miviri inoverenga zvisina kururama mupendero wemiganhu. Sarudza umwe wayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.0: Pamutsara mumwe nemumwe, tsvaga chikamu chinoenderana neizwi remuganhu raanoshandisa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bvunza pamutsara mumwe nemumwe: izwi remuganhu iroro rinoverenga nhamba yakanyorwa padyo naro here?
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.explain: Mitsara 2 ne 5 haina kururama. '5명 이하' inosanganisira 5, saka boka renhengo shanu rinobvumirwa. '10시간 이상' inosanganisira 10, saka maawa 10 chaiwo anowana chitupa. Mitsara 1, 3 ne 4 inoverenga mipendero nemazvo.

n-k-k8-03.title: Kuedza nzira yegiramari yemumwe wekirasi
n-k-k8-03.goal: Edza mutemo wegiramari wemumwe wekirasi nemienzaniso, sarudza kuti uchiruramisa sei, wobva wanyora mutsara wako unopesana.
n-k-k8-03.material:
"Mumwe wekirasi akanyora izvi mubhuku.

  규칙: -(으)ㄴ/는데 = 'but'. 앞의 내용과 뒤의 내용이 서로 반대일 때 쓴다.

Mumwe wekirasi anokubvunza: 'Is my rule always right?' Chiedze."
n-k-k8-03.prereq.1: Unogona kunyora mutsara wechiKorea wakareruka munguva yakapfuura kana yazvino
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara upi muenzaniso unopesana, apo -(으)ㄴ/는데 yakarurama asi zvikamu zviviri HAZVIPESANI?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsara wega wega uedze kuisa 'but' pakati pezvikamu zvawo zviviri: unonzwika wakasikwa munguva dzose here?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti chikamu chechipiri chinoshamisa kana chinopesana nechekutanga, kana kuti chimwe chidimbu chinotevera chenyaya.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.a: Pano chikamu chechipiri chinopesana nezvaunotarisira kubva ku'pretty', saka chinoenderana nemutemo uye hachisi muenzaniso unopesana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.b: Chikamu chechipiri chinoshamisa kubva pachekutanga, saka chinoenderana nemutemo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.d: Mhedzisiro inopesana nekushanda, saka inoenderana nemutemo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.explain: Mu c chikamu chekutanga chinongopa nzvimbo (ndakaenda kumart) uye chikamu chechipiri chinoti ndakawana chii. Hapana chinopesana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kana uchiramba mutemo kana kuchinja zvawunoti.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti kururamisa kwako kuchiri kutsanangura mitsara yekupesana nemuenzaniso unopesana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.a: Chengeta mutemo sezvawakaita, nokuti mitsara yakawanda ye -는데 inopesana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.a: Mutemo unoti 'nguva dzose' unoparadzwa nemuenzaniso mumwe unopesana zvakajeka, kunyange mitsara yakawanda yakaenderana nawo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.b: Taura kuti -는데 inowanzopesana asi inogonawo kuisa nzvimbo yezvinotevera.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.c: Taura kuti -는데 inowanzoisa nzvimbo, uye mienzaniso yekupesana ndiyo kukanganisa.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.c: Mitsara yekupesana ichiKorea chakajairika; mutemo wacho wakamanikana, asi hausi wakanganisa zvachose.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.d: Taura kuti -는데 inopesana mukunyora, asi mukutaura haipesane.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.d: Hapana chiri mumienzaniso chinoenderana nekutaura pamberi pekunyora.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.explain: Mutemo unoti 'kupesana chete' unoparadzwa nemuenzaniso mumwe wakanaka unopesana. Kururamisa kunochengeta chakarurama (kupesana ndiko kushandiswa kumwe) uye kuwedzera kushandiswa kusipo (kuisa nzvimbo yechikamu chinotevera).
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mutsara wako wechiKorea une -(으)ㄴ/는데 apo zvikamu zviviri HAZVIPESANI. Wobva wawedzera notsi pfupi (chiRungu kana chiKorea) inoti chikamu chekutanga chinoitira chikamu chechipiri chii.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.0: Funga nguva yawakaisa nzvimbo usati wabvunza kana kuudza chimwe chinhu: kupi, riini, wakaona chii.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.1: Mushure mekunyora, edza kuisa 'but' pakati pezvikamu zvako zviviri; kana ichinzwika zvisina kururama, une muenzaniso unopesana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: 'But' yaizova yakanganisa pakati pezvikamu zviviri zvemutsara wangu here?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Notsi yangu inoti chikamu chekutanga chinoitira chii (semuenzaniso chinopa nzvimbo kana chikonzero chekubvunza) here?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.model.0: 내일 시간이 있는데 같이 영화 볼래요? (Chikamu chekutanga chinopa mamiriro, wobva wakoka.)

n-k-k8-04.title: Chikamu chekudzorerwa mari chinoramba chichichinja
n-k-k8-04.topic: mitemo nemamiriro: mutemo, kusasanganisira, kusasanganisira kwekusasanganisira
n-k-k8-04.goal: Gadzirisa sarudzo yekudzorerwa mari sezvo zvikamu zvakawanda zvemitemo yetikiti zvichiwoneka, shandisa zvikamu kumutengi wechipiri, uye utsanangure kuti mhinduro yakachinja sei.
n-k-k8-04.material: Mina akatenga tikiti yeconcert mazuva 5 apfuura. Concert iri mazuva 10 kubva nhasi. Haagone kuenda, saka nhasi anokumbira kudzorerwa mari. Mitemo yetikiti inooneka chikamu chimwe panguva.
n-k-k8-04.prereq.1: Unogona kuverenga chikamu chepamutemo chine nhamba
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe nenhevedzano, sarudza mhinduro yakanakisisa ku 'Mina anogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari kwakadii?' uchishandisa zvikamu zvaratidzwa kusvika zvino chete.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Shandisa zvikamu zvaunogona kuona chete; usafungidzire zvichauya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nguva imwe neimwe, tarisa mazuva aMina (mazuva 5 kubva pakutenga, mazuva 10 kusvika concert) nechikamu chimwe nechimwe chakaratidzwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mina anogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari kwakadii?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Chikamu chinotaura mutemo pasina kusasanganisira kusvika zvino. 'Kudzorerwa mari kwakadzimwa' ndiyo mhinduro inonzwisisika, kunyange muverengi ane hanya achiyeuka kuti kusasanganisira kunogona kuuya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hapana muchikamu ichi chinopa mari yekudzorerwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chikamu ichi hachitaure chinhu nezvemari kana kudzorerwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Handisati ndave nechokwadi: zvikamu zvakawanda zvingauya.

n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Nechikamu ichi chawedzerwa, Mina anogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari kwakadii?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Mina anokumbira mazuva 10 concert isati yasvika, ari kare pane '7일 전', saka chikamu ② chinoratidzika chichimupa kudzorerwa mari kubvisa mari. Asi chikamu chitsva chingaramba chichichidzikamisa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Chikamu ② kusasanganisira ('다만') ku①, uye Mina anokumbira mazuva 10 concert isati yasvika, saka ② chinoratidzika chichishanda.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Mari ye10% inobviswa, saka hazvisi kudzorerwa mari kwakazara.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Nezvikamu zvose zvitatu, Mina anogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari kwakadii?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Chikamu ③ chinowedzera mamiriro echipiri ku②: chikumbiro chinofanira kuuya mukati memazuva 3 ekutenga. Mina akatenga mazuva 5 apfuura, saka ② hachishandi uye chikamu ① chinosarudza: hapana kudzorerwa mari.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Akatenga mazuva 5 apfuura, anopfuura mazuva 3, saka ② hachishandi kwaari zvakare.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hapana chikamu chinopa kudzorerwa mari kwakazara mumamiriro ake.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Zvikamu zvitatu izvi zvatogadzirisa mazuva aMina; unogona kutaura 'subject to other terms', asi sarudzo inoenderana nezvaunazvo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: Mutemo wekutanga wakapa 'kwete', kusasanganisira kwakaita kuti ive 'ehe, kubvisa mari', uye chikamu chekupedzisira chakadzikamisa kusasanganisira uku zvakare. Mashoko 다만 ne제2항은 ... 경우에만 anoratidza matanho akadaro. Verenga zvikamu zvose usati wasarudza.

n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Chikamu chinopa kusasanganisira chinoshanda kana mamiriro ose aro akasangana chete.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.a: Kudzorerwa mari kubvisa mari ye10%, nokuti akakumbira mukati memazuva 3.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.a: Chikamu ② chine mamiriro echipiri: chikumbiro chinofanira kuuya mazuva 7 zvishoma concert isati yasvika.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.b: Hapana kudzorerwa mari, nokuti nguva yekupedzisira yemazuva 7 ye② yapfuura.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.c: Kudzorerwa mari kwakazara, nokuti akatenga tikiti nezuro chete.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.c: Hapana muzvikamu chinopa kudzorerwa mari kwakazara pakutenga kwazvino.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.d: Hapana kudzorerwa mari, nokuti ② ndeyematikiti akatengwa mazuva 3 kana kupfuura apfuura.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.d: Chikamu ③ chinoti zvakapesana: ② chinoshanda mukati memazuva 3 ekutenga chete.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.explain: Jun anosangana nemamiriro emazuva 3 e③, asi chikamu ② chinodawo chikumbiro mazuva 7 concert isati yasvika, uye mazuva 4 chete ndiwo asara. Saka ② hachishandi, uye ① inoti hapana kudzorerwa mari.
